2. A residential agreement carries a Residential New Service Deposit still in assessed status. A second deposit on that same agreement is not assessed while the first stands assessed.

title: Security Deposit Interest Year: Rate of Its Opening Calendar Year
content:
**Definition.** The year being credited on a Security Deposit anniversary begins on the period end of the latest interest credit on the deposit, or on the fully secured date when no interest has been credited yet, and it covers the 12 months ending on the anniversary.

**Rule.** The rate of the calendar year in which the year being credited began is 4.02% (0.0402) when it began in 2025, 3.85% (0.0385) when it began in 2024, and 4.17% (0.0417), the annual interest rate of every Security Deposit kind, otherwise.

## Rate of the opening calendar year

| The year being credited began in | Rate of that calendar year |
|---|---|
| Calendar 2025 | 4.02% |
| Calendar 2024 | 3.85% |
| Any other calendar year | 4.17% |

## Finding where the year began (hypothetical deposits)

| Deposit record | Year being credited began on | Rate of the opening calendar year |
|---|---|---|
| Latest interest credit with period end 14 October 2025 | 14 October 2025 | 4.02% |
| No interest credit yet; fully secured on 3 November 2024 | 3 November 2024 | 3.85% |
| Latest interest credit with period end 9 February 2026 | 9 February 2026 | 4.17% |
| Interest credits with period ends 1 July 2024 and 1 July 2025 | 1 July 2025 (the latest) | 4.02% |

title: Installment Plan of a Security Deposit on a New Agreement
content:
**Clause.** A Security Deposit on a new agreement is paid in the most installments of its kind, reduced until each installment reaches the kind's smallest installment, the opening installment being the required amount recorded on the deposit divided by that count and rounded down to the cent, the last installment carrying the remainder.

**Number of installments.** The number starts from the kind's most installments, is never fewer than one, and is then reduced one at a time until the required amount divided by the number is at least the kind's smallest installment. The number is recorded with the opening installment.

**Later installments.** After the opening installment, the rest of the required amount is paid in equal installments over the remaining number, each rounded down to the cent, the last installment carrying the remainder, each later installment due 30 calendar days after the previous one.


## Worked examples (hypothetical deposits)

| Hypothetical kind's figures | Required amount (USD) | Number of installments | Opening installment (USD) | Later installments (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Most 3, smallest 25.00 | 620.00 | 3 | 206.66 | 206.67 and 206.67 |
| Most 3, smallest 25.00 | 60.00 | 2 (60.00 over 3 is 20.00, below 25.00) | 30.00 | 30.00 |
| Most 2, smallest 100.00 | 251.00 | 2 | 125.50 | 125.50 |
| Most 1, smallest 100.00 | 6000.00 | 1 | 6000.00 | None |

In the first row, 620.00 divided by 3 is 206.666..., rounded down to 206.66; the remaining 413.34 is paid in 2 equal installments of 206.67.

title: Security Deposit on a New Agreement: Paying the Opening Installment
content:
A Security Deposit assessed on a new agreement is paid by the customer directly to the deposit, and its opening installment is worked out on the day it is paid.

**Numbering.** The installments of a deposit on a new agreement are numbered from 1 for the opening installment, each number recorded once on the deposit.

**Due dates.** The first installment is due the kind's first-installment days after assessment, and each later installment of a deposit on a new agreement is due 30 calendar days after the previous one, whatever the installment schedule of its kind.

| Installment | Number recorded | Due |
|---|---|---|
| Opening installment | 1 | The kind's first-installment days after assessment |
| Next installment | 2 | 30 calendar days after installment 1 is due |
| Each later installment | Next number | 30 calendar days after the previous one |

## Paying the installment: `pay_deposit_installment_d7ce4a9b`

**Capability.** The tool pays, as the customer, an installment of a newly assessed Security Deposit. It books a cash deposit payment received today on the deposit under the stated installment number, records on the deposit the number of installments in which it is being paid, and raises the cash held on the deposit by the amount paid. The payment then appears among the deposit's transactions, and the deposit shows the installment count and the new held amount.

**How it is invoked.** It is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `deposit_id` | The deposit reference number of the newly assessed deposit being paid, as given to the customer from the assessment receipt or the security-deposit lookup | Reference number |
| `installment_number` | The installment number this payment satisfies on the deposit | Integer counting from 1 for the deposit's earliest installment |
| `installment_count` | The number of installments in which the deposit is being paid | Positive integer |
| `amount` | The amount paid | USD with 2 decimal places, a positive amount rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A one-line text receipt naming the new deposit transaction reference number, the installment number and the installment count, the amount received in USD with 2 decimal places, the deposit and the resulting held amount; the transaction reference number in the receipt confirms the payment was received.

title: Security Deposit Refund by Check After a Passed Review
content:
A held Security Deposit whose satisfactory payment review is passed is refunded in full on or after its refund review date, by check where the kind allows a check on request and the customer asks for a check.

Once the refund is issued the deposit stands refunded and holds no cash or interest.

## Issuing the refund: `refund_deposit_by_check_703d791f`

**Capability.** The tool refunds a held Security Deposit in full by check on a passed satisfactory payment review. It books a full refund of the stated amount, paid by check and dated today, on the deposit, sets the deposit's status to refunded with today as its status date, and brings the cash and interest held on the deposit to zero. The refund then appears among the deposit's transactions and the deposit shows as refunded.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `deposit_id` | The deposit reference number of the held deposit being refunded, as returned by the security-deposit lookup for the customer | Reference number |
| `refund_amount` | The full amount refunded by check | USD with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A one-line text receipt naming the new deposit transaction reference number, the deposit, the amount refunded by check in USD with 2 decimal places and the deposit's new status (refunded); the refunded status in the receipt confirms the refund was issued.

title: Business Security Deposit Recalculation: Payment Record Multiple
content:
**Credit department rule.** The multiple applied to the recalculated requirement of a held business Security Deposit follows the secured Electric Service Agreement's payment record in the 12 months ending on the recalculation date, late payment charges being counted after deducting one for each courtesy late-charge waiver credit.

- Where 3 or more late payment charges are counted or any payment reversal was posted, the multiple is the kind's deposit multiple plus 0.5.
- Where no late payment charge is counted and no payment reversal was posted, it is the kind's deposit multiple less 0.5.
- Otherwise it is the kind's deposit multiple.

## Resulting multiples for the business kinds

| Security Deposit kind | Kind's deposit multiple | 3 or more counted, or a reversal | None counted and no reversal | Otherwise |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | 2.0 | 2.5 | 1.5 | 2.0 |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | 2.5 | 3.0 | 2.0 | 2.5 |
| Large Power Service Deposit | 2.0 | 2.5 | 1.5 | 2.0 |

## Truth table (hypothetical 12-month records)

| Late payment charges posted | Courtesy waiver credits | Counted | Payment reversals | Multiple |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Kind's multiple less 0.5 |
| 1 | 1 | 0 | 0 | Kind's multiple less 0.5 |
| 2 | 0 | 2 | 0 | Kind's multiple |
| 4 | 1 | 3 | 0 | Kind's multiple plus 0.5 |
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | Kind's multiple plus 0.5 |

title: Security Deposit Payments and Full Security
content:
**Terms governing payment of a Security Deposit and the day it becomes fully secured.**

1. Deposit installments are paid directly to the Security Deposit and never through the service bill balance.
2. Deposit payments are accepted only while the deposit is in assessed status, as the deposit record shows it when the payment is made, for the deposit the payment is made to.
3. On the day the deposit becomes fully secured, the refund review date is set to the fully secured date plus the kind's review months, counted in calendar months.

## Clauses no longer in force

- The regular installment is the required amount divided by the installment count, rounded down to the cent, and the last installment carries the remainder. (no longer in force; superseded by the current basis)
- Each installment number is recorded once. (no longer in force; superseded by the current basis)
- The deposit becomes held on the day the cash received reaches the required amount, or on the day an accepted instrument for the full required amount is lodged: a surety bond, an irrevocable letter of credit or a third-party guarantee, each where the kind accepts it. (no longer in force; superseded by the current basis)

## Payment acceptance by status

| Deposit status | Deposit payment accepted? |
|---|---|
| Assessed | Yes |
| Held, waived, refunded, applied to final bill or cancelled | No |

## Review date examples (hypothetical dates)

| Fully secured date | Kind's review months | Refund review date |
|---|---|---|
| 15 March | 12 | 15 March of the following year |
| 15 March | 24 | 15 March two years later |
| 2 October | 36 | 2 October three years later |

**Is a deposit installment added to the customer's electric bill?** No. It is paid directly to the deposit and never through the service bill balance.

title: Estimating the Monthly Bill of a Pending Electric Service Agreement
content:
For a Security Deposit assessed on a new agreement still pending start, the estimate of the pending agreement's monthly bill is drawn from the customer's records.

**Sister agreement.** Another Electric Service Agreement of the customer, in active status, on the same rate schedule as the new agreement, that carries, or carried, the customer's deposit of the same kind.

**Rule.** Regular bills are counted in the 12 months ending on the assessment date.

| The customer's records | Estimate of the pending agreement's monthly bill |
|---|---|
| A sister agreement with at least 12 regular bills in the 12 months | That sister agreement's billing basis |
| A sister agreement on the same rate schedule with at least the kind's fewest regular bills but fewer than 12 | The mean of those bills, rounded to the cent |
| Otherwise | The kind's default average monthly bill |

## Figures by kind

| Security Deposit kind | Bill months counted | Fewest regular bills | Default average monthly bill (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Residential New Service Deposit | 12 | 6 | 142.00 |
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | 12 | 3 | 310.00 |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | 12 | 3 | 2400.00 |
| Large Power Service Deposit | 12 | 3 | 41500.00 |

## Cases (hypothetical customers)

1. A residential customer opens a second Schedule RS agreement. Its existing active Schedule RS agreement carries the customer's Residential New Service Deposit and has 12 regular bills in the 12 months: the estimate is that agreement's billing basis.
2. The same, but the existing agreement has 8 regular bills in the 12 months: at least 6 and fewer than 12, so the estimate is the mean of those 8 bills.
3. The existing agreement has 4 regular bills: fewer than 6, so the estimate is USD 142.00.
4. A business customer opens a Schedule GD agreement and has no other active Schedule GD agreement: the estimate is USD 2400.00.

title: Plan Size for a New Agreement Security Deposit by Deposit Size
content:
The plan size of a Security Deposit on a new agreement, the number of installments its payment plan is built on, follows the deposit's size and the customer's payment reversals.

**Rule.** Payment reversals are read on any of the customer's Electric Service Agreements in the 24 months ending on the payment date.

1. Where the required amount is at least 4 times the kind's minimum deposit and no payment reversal was posted in those months, the plan size is 3 times the kind's most installments.
2. Where the required amount is at least 2 times the kind's minimum deposit but less than 4 times it, with no such payment reversal, the plan size is the kind's most installments plus 1.
3. Otherwise the plan size is the kind's most installments.

## Thresholds and plan sizes by kind

| Security Deposit kind | Minimum deposit (USD) | 4 times minimum (USD) | 2 times minimum (USD) | Most installments | Plan size: 4 times or more, no reversal | 2 times or more but under 4 times, no reversal | Otherwise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential New Service Deposit | 100.00 | 400.00 | 200.00 | 3 | 9 | 4 | 3 |
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | 250.00 | 1000.00 | 500.00 | 2 | 6 | 3 | 2 |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | 1000.00 | 4000.00 | 2000.00 | 1 | 3 | 2 | 1 |
| Large Power Service Deposit | 10000.00 | 40000.00 | 20000.00 | 1 | 3 | 2 | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical Small Commercial Service Deposit, no reversal)

| Required amount (USD) | Plan size |
|---|---|
| 1000.00 | 6 |
| 999.00 | 3 |
| 500.00 | 3 |
| 499.00 | 2 |

With a payment reversal on any of the customer's agreements in the 24 months, each row above is 2.

title: Premise Heating and the Monthly Bill Estimate for a New Security Deposit
content:
A monthly bill estimate drawn from a sister agreement, for a Security Deposit on a new agreement still pending start, is adjusted for the way the new premise is heated. The heating of each premise is the primary space-heating source recorded on its Electric Service Agreement from the start order, electric or non-electric.

| Estimate drawn from | New premise heating | Sister premise heating | Estimate multiplied by |
|---|---|---|---|
| A sister agreement | Electric | Non-electric | 1.3 |
| A sister agreement | Non-electric | Electric | 0.8 |
| A sister agreement | Same source as the sister premise | Same source as the new premise | Taken as it is |
| The kind's default average monthly bill | Any | Any | Taken as it is |

The estimate so adjusted is rounded to the cent and is the average monthly bill recorded on the deposit.

## Cases (hypothetical estimate of USD 160.00 drawn from a sister agreement)

- New premise electric, sister premise non-electric: USD 160.00 times 1.3, which is USD 208.00.
- New premise non-electric, sister premise electric: USD 160.00 times 0.8, which is USD 128.00.
- Both electric: USD 160.00.
- Hypothetical estimate of USD 157.37, new premise electric, sister premise non-electric: USD 204.581, rounded to the cent USD 204.58.

title: Business Security Deposit: Recalculated Requirement
content:
**Clause.** The recalculated requirement of a held business Security Deposit is the deposit multiple of its kind times the mean of the secured agreement's regular bills issued in the kind's number of bill months (12) ending on the recalculation date, the mean rounded to the cent, and the product rounded to the cent and then up to the next whole dollar, raised to the kind's minimum deposit and limited to its maximum deposit. With fewer than the kind's fewest regular bills, the kind's default average monthly bill stands in for the mean.

The mean so used, rounded to the cent, is the average monthly bill recorded on the deposit with the recalculated requirement.


## Order of the calculation

1. Mean of the regular bills issued in the 12 months ending on the recalculation date, rounded to the cent (or the default average monthly bill where too few bills exist).
2. That mean times the kind's deposit multiple, rounded to the cent.
3. Rounded up to the next whole dollar.
4. Raised to the minimum deposit, then limited to the maximum deposit.

## Worked examples (hypothetical agreements of a kind whose multiple is 2.5, minimum USD 1000.00, maximum USD 50000.00, fewest bills 3, default average monthly bill USD 2400.00)

| Regular bills in the 12 months | Total of those bills (USD) | Mean (USD) | Times 2.5 | Whole dollars up | Recalculated requirement (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | 37230.00 | 3102.50 | 7756.25 | 7757 | 7757.00 |
| 2 | (too few) | 2400.00 (default) | 6000.00 | 6000 | 6000.00 |
| 12 | 3600.00 | 300.00 | 750.00 | 750 | 1000.00 (raised to the minimum) |

The average monthly bill recorded with each requirement is the mean in the third column.

title: Recent Load and the Billing Basis of a Business Security Deposit
content:
The monthly bill figure on which the recalculated requirement of a held business Security Deposit rests, its billing basis, follows the secured Electric Service Agreement's recent load.

**Definitions.** All means are of the agreement's regular bills issued in the stated months ending on the recalculation date, each mean rounded to the cent.
- **Twelve-month mean**: mean of the regular bills issued in the 12 months ending on the recalculation date.
- **Recent mean**: mean of the regular bills issued in the 3 months ending on the recalculation date.
- **Six-month mean**: mean of the regular bills issued in the 6 months ending on the recalculation date.
- **Average billing demand**: the billing demand (kW) of the twelve-month regular bills averaged over those bills; the latest billing demand is the billing demand on the agreement's latest regular bill.

**Rule.**

| Recent load on the Electric Service Agreement | Billing basis |
|---|---|
| The recent mean exceeds the twelve-month mean times 1.25, and the latest billing demand exceeds the average billing demand | The recent mean |
| The recent mean is below the twelve-month mean times 0.75, and the latest billing demand is below the average billing demand | The six-month mean |
| Otherwise | The twelve-month mean |

The billing basis so chosen, rounded to the cent, is the average monthly bill recorded on the deposit with the recalculated requirement.

## Cases (hypothetical agreement: twelve-month mean USD 3000.00, average billing demand 180.0 kW)

| Recent mean (USD) | Latest billing demand (kW) | Six-month mean (USD) | Billing basis (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4000.00 (above 3750.00) | 210.0 | 3500.00 | 4000.00 |
| 3700.00 (not above 3750.00) | 210.0 | 3400.00 | 3000.00 |
| 2000.00 (below 2250.00) | 150.0 | 2400.00 | 2400.00 |
| 2000.00 (below 2250.00) | 190.0 | 2400.00 | 3000.00 |

title: Amount of a Security Deposit Refund on a Passed Review
content:
**Commission rates for interest paid within a refund.** The Commission's deposit interest rates are 3.85% (0.0385) for calendar 2024, 4.02% (0.0402) for calendar 2025 and 4.17% (0.0417), the annual interest rate of every Security Deposit kind, for calendar 2026 onward.

**Clause.** A passed review refunds the cash received less the cash already refunded, plus the interest credited on the deposit, plus interest on the cash received for the period since the latest interest credit at the Commission's deposit interest rate for the calendar year of the refund date, by days over 365, rounded to the cent.

**Terms.** The cash received is the total of the deposit payments; the cash already refunded is the total of earlier refunds paid out of the deposit; the interest credited is the total of the interest credits on the deposit. The period since the latest interest credit runs from the period end of the latest interest credit on the deposit, or from the fully secured date when none has been credited, to the refund date, its days counted from the start date to the refund date, the start date not counted.

## Worked example (hypothetical deposit)

Cash received USD 480.00; nothing refunded earlier; one interest credit of USD 20.02 with period end 12 May 2026; refund date 1 September 2026.

| Element | Figure |
|---|---|
| Cash received less cash already refunded | 480.00 |
| Interest credited | 20.02 |
| Days from 12 May 2026 (not counted) to 1 September 2026 | 112 |
| Rate for calendar 2026 | 4.17% |
| Interest for the period: 480.00 times 4.17% times 112 over 365 | 6.1419, rounded to 6.14 |
| Refund | 480.00 plus 20.02 plus 6.14, which is 506.16 |

title: Security Deposit Review Extension Period
content:
**Clause.** Where a held Security Deposit's satisfactory payment review is not passed, the extension of its refund review date is the review extension period of the deposit's kind, counted from the review date recorded on the deposit. The extension is a whole number of calendar months and is never less than 1 month.


## Elements of the clause

- **Quantity**: the number of whole calendar months by which the refund review date moves out.
- **Figure applied**: the review extension period of the deposit's kind.
- **Starting point**: the review date recorded on the deposit, not the day on which the review is decided.
- **Lowest value**: 1 month.

## Worked example (hypothetical deposit)

A held deposit of a kind whose review extension period is 6 months carries a recorded refund review date of 14 March. Its review is decided on 2 April and is not passed.

1. Extension: the kind's review extension period, 6 months.
2. Lowest value check: 6 months is not less than 1 month.
3. New refund review date: 6 calendar months from the recorded 14 March, which is 14 September. The decision day of 2 April does not move the starting point.

## Basis questions

**Is the extension counted from the day the review is decided?**
No. It is counted from the review date recorded on the deposit.

**Can the extension be a part of a month?**
No. It is a whole number of calendar months.

title: Security Deposit Review Not Passed: Moving the Refund Review Date
content:
A held Security Deposit whose satisfactory payment review is not passed stays held, and its refund review date moves out, counted from the review date recorded on the deposit, by a whole number of calendar months. The deposit keeps its status and its cash; only its refund review date changes.

The number of months is worked out on the decision day, the day on which the review is decided, and every count, date span and status the calculation reads is taken on that day.

## Business effect

| Before the extension is recorded | After it is recorded |
|---|---|
| Deposit held, review date as recorded | Deposit still held, cash unchanged |
| Refund review date on the deposit | Moved forward by the stated number of whole calendar months |

## Recording the extension: `extend_deposit_review_04d6c850`

**Capability.** The tool records that a Security Deposit stays held because its satisfactory payment review was not passed, moving its refund review date out by a stated number of whole calendar months. The new review date is the review date currently recorded on the deposit, shifted forward by the stated number of calendar months to the same day of the month, or to the last day of that month when the month is shorter. The new date shows on the deposit at once.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `deposit_id` | The deposit reference number of the Security Deposit whose review date moves, as returned by the security-deposit lookup for the customer | Reference number |
| `extension_months` | The number of whole calendar months by which the recorded refund review date moves out | Positive integer count of months, no fractions |

**Return.** A one-line text receipt naming the deposit reference number, the review date that was recorded, the new refund review date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the number of months applied; the new date appearing in the receipt confirms the change was recorded. If no deposit carries the reference number, nothing is changed and the reply says so.

## Illustration of the date shift (hypothetical inputs)

| Recorded refund review date | `extension_months` | New refund review date |
|---|---|---|
| 14 March | 6 | 14 September |
| 31 August | 6 | 28 February (29 February in a leap year) |
| 10 January | 13 | 10 February of the following year |

title: Security Deposit Review Shortfall: Length of the Extension
content:
When a held Security Deposit's satisfactory payment review is not passed, the length of the extension of its refund review date follows the shortfall of the review, read from the secured Electric Service Agreement's records.

## Counting rules

The review window is the kind's review months ending on the decision day, the day on which the review is decided. In that window:

- **late payment charges** are counted on the secured Electric Service Agreement, deducting one for each courtesy late-charge waiver credit posted on that agreement in the window;
- **returned payments** are the payment reversals posted on the secured agreement;
- **disconnections** are the reconnection charges posted on any of the customer's Electric Service Agreements, plus one when any of the customer's agreements is disconnected on the decision day.

## Length of the extension

| Shortfall of the review | Length of the extension |
|---|---|
| A disconnection is counted, or two or more returned payments are counted | The full review months of the kind |
| The counted late payment charges exceed the kind's late payment allowance by exactly one, and no returned payment is counted | One half (0.5) of the kind's review extension period |
| Every other case | The kind's review extension period |

The first row governs whenever its condition holds; the second applies only where the first does not.

## Figures by kind

| Security Deposit kind | Review window and full review months | Review extension period (months) | One half of it (months) | Late payment allowance | Counted late payment charges that are exactly one over |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential New Service Deposit | 12 | 6 | 3 | 2 | 3 |
| Residential Reestablishment Deposit | 12 | 6 | 3 | 1 | 2 |
| Residential Unauthorized Use Deposit | 24 | 12 | 6 | 0 | 1 |
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | 24 | 12 | 6 | 2 | 3 |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | 24 | 12 | 6 | 2 | 3 |
| Large Power Service Deposit | 36 | 12 | 6 | 1 | 2 |

## Cases (hypothetical Residential New Service Deposit, allowance 2)

| Late payment charges posted | Courtesy waiver credits | Counted late | Returned payments | Disconnections | Length |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 1 | 3 | 0 | 0 | 3 months (one half of 6) |
| 4 | 0 | 4 | 0 | 0 | 6 months |
| 3 | 0 | 3 | 1 | 0 | 6 months |
| 1 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 0 | 12 months |
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 (reconnection charge on another agreement) | 12 months |

title: Security Deposit Satisfactory Payment Review
content:
A held Security Deposit is reviewed on its refund review date.

## Clauses in force

1. **Timing.** The refund may be made only on or after the refund review date recorded on the deposit. Dates are compared as calendar dates, and the review date itself qualifies; the offset from the review date is 0 days.
2. **Pass tests.** The review passes when all of the following hold for the review period, which is the kind's review months ending on the refund review date:
   - the late payment charges posted on the secured agreement in the period, excluding charges later waived by a courtesy late-charge waiver credit, are no more than the kind's allowance;
   - the payment reversals (returned payments) posted on the secured agreement in the period are no more than the kind's allowance;
   - where the kind requires it, the disconnections are zero, disconnections being the reconnection charges posted on any of the customer's agreements in the period plus one for each of the customer's agreements currently in disconnected status.
3. **Guarantees.** A third-party guarantee is released after the kind's guarantee release months of satisfactory payment, and no cash is refunded for it.

## Clauses no longer in force

- A passed review refunds the cash received plus interest through the refund date, by the kind's default method (a credit to the service agreement), or by check where the kind allows it and the customer asks for a check. (no longer in force; superseded by the current basis)
- A failed review leaves the deposit held and moves the refund review date out by the kind's review extension period. (no longer in force; superseded by the current basis)

## Timing boundary (hypothetical date)

| Refund review date recorded | Date considered | May the refund be made? |
|---|---|---|
| 20 August | 19 August | No |
| 20 August | 20 August | Yes |
| 20 August | 21 August | Yes |

## Worked pass test (hypothetical deposit)

A Residential New Service Deposit, allowance of 2 late payment charges and 0 returned payments, no disconnection permitted. In its 12-month review period the secured agreement shows 3 late payment charges, one of them later waived by a courtesy late-charge waiver credit, no payment reversal, no reconnection charge on any of the customer's agreements, and no agreement disconnected now. Counted late payment charges: 2, within the allowance; returned payments: 0; disconnections: 0. All pass tests hold and the review passes.

title: Security Deposit Satisfactory Payment Review: Limits by Kind
content:
A held Security Deposit is reviewed for satisfactory payment on its refund review date. The limits, periods and refund terms of the review differ by kind as shown.

| Security Deposit kind | Review falls due (months after the deposit became fully held) | Late payment charges allowed in the review period | Returned payments allowed in the review period | Review requires no disconnection for nonpayment on any of the customer's agreements | Review extension period after a review not passed (months) | Refund paid by default | Customer may elect a check |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential New Service Deposit | 12 | 2 | 0 | Yes | 6 | Bill credit to the service agreement | No |
| Residential Reestablishment Deposit | 12 | 1 | 0 | Yes | 6 | Bill credit to the service agreement | No |
| Residential Unauthorized Use Deposit | 24 | 0 | 0 | Yes | 12 | Bill credit to the service agreement | No |
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | 24 | 2 | 0 | Yes | 12 | Bill credit to the service agreement | Yes |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | 24 | 2 | 0 | Yes | 12 | Bill credit to the service agreement | Yes |
| Large Power Service Deposit | 36 | 1 | 0 | Yes | 12 | Bill credit to the service agreement | Yes |

## Column meanings

- **Review falls due**: the months after the deposit became fully held at which the satisfactory payment review falls due.
- **Late payment charges allowed** and **returned payments allowed**: the most of each that may occur during the review period for the deposit to be refunded.
- **No disconnection required**: whether a disconnection for nonpayment on any of the customer's agreements during the review period prevents the refund.
- **Review extension period**: the months by which the review date is moved out after a review that is not passed.
- **Refund paid by default** and **check on election**: how a refund is paid unless the customer elects otherwise, and whether the customer may elect a check instead.

## Comparisons across kinds

- A Residential New Service Deposit tolerates 2 late payment charges in its 12-month review period; a Residential Reestablishment Deposit tolerates 1 in the same length of period.
- No kind tolerates a returned payment: the allowance is 0 throughout.
- Only the three business kinds allow the customer to elect a check; every residential refund is paid as a bill credit to the service agreement.
- The Large Power Service Deposit has the longest review period, 36 months, and a review extension period of 12 months.

title: Service Length and the Installment Plan of an Additional Business Security Deposit
content:
**Clause.** Service length lengthens the installment plan of an additional amount owed on a business Security Deposit: a secured Electric Service Agreement in service at least 120 whole months on the payment date adds 2 installments, one in service at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months adds 1, and any other adds none.

**Counting.** Service length runs from the agreement's start date to the payment date. Whole months between two dates are counted from the earlier date to the same day of a later month, a month whose day has not yet been reached on the later date not counting.

| Whole months in service on the payment date | Installments added |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 2 |
| 60 to 119 | 1 |
| Fewer than 60 | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Agreement start date | Payment date | Whole months | Added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 July 2016 | 12 July 2026 | 120 | 2 |
| 12 July 2016 | 11 July 2026 | 119 | 1 |
| 12 July 2021 | 12 July 2026 | 60 | 1 |
| 12 July 2021 | 11 July 2026 | 59 | None |

**Counting.** Service length runs from the agreement's start date to the decision day. Whole months between two dates are counted from the earlier date to the same day of a later month, a month whose day has not yet been reached on the later date not counting.

| 120 or more | 2 |

title: Business Security Deposit Recalculation: Service Length Reduction of the Multiple
content:
The service length of the secured Electric Service Agreement lowers the multiple applied to the recalculated requirement of a held business Security Deposit.

**Clause.** An agreement in service at least 120 whole months on the recalculation date takes 0.5 off the multiple; one in service at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months takes 0.25 off; any other takes nothing off.

**Counting.** Service length runs from the agreement's start date to the recalculation date. Whole months between two dates are counted from the earlier date to the same day of a later month, a month whose day has not yet been reached on the later date not counting.

| Whole months in service on the recalculation date | Taken off the multiple |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 0.5 |
| 60 to 119 | 0.25 |
| Fewer than 60 | Nothing |

| 1 September 2016 | 31 August 2026 | 119 | 0.25 |

title: Billing Basis of a Sister Electric Service Agreement
content:
The billing basis of a sister agreement, the customer's other active Electric Service Agreement on the new agreement's rate schedule that carries or carried the customer's Security Deposit of the same kind, follows its recent load.

**Means and usage.** Means are of the sister agreement's regular bills issued in the stated months ending on the assessment date, each rounded to the cent: the recent mean over 3 months, the six-month mean over 6 months and the twelve-month mean over 12 months. The twelve-month average kWh is the total kWh of the twelve-month regular bills over their number; the latest kWh are those on the sister agreement's latest regular bill.

| Recent load of the sister agreement | Billing basis |
|---|---|
| The recent mean exceeds the twelve-month mean times 1.25, and the latest kWh exceed the twelve-month average kWh | The recent mean |
| The recent mean is below the twelve-month mean times 0.75, and the latest kWh are below the twelve-month average kWh | The six-month mean |
| Otherwise | The twelve-month mean |

## Cases (hypothetical sister agreement: twelve-month mean USD 160.00, twelve-month average 1100 kWh)

| Recent mean (USD) | Latest kWh | Six-month mean (USD) | Billing basis (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 210.00 (above 200.00) | 1450 | 185.00 | 210.00 |
| 210.00 (above 200.00) | 1050 | 185.00 | 160.00 |
| 200.00 (not above 200.00) | 1450 | 180.00 | 160.00 |
| 110.00 (below 120.00) | 800 | 130.00 | 130.00 |

title: Security Deposit Transfer When a Customer Moves
content:
A held Security Deposit whose kind allows transfer on a move moves to the customer's new service agreement when the customer stops service at one address and starts at another.

## Conditions

1. The deposit moves only to a service agreement of the same customer in pending start or active status, as the agreement record shows it.
2. The fully secured date, the refund review date and the interest periods continue unchanged after the move.

## Status of the receiving agreement

| Status of the customer's new service agreement | May the deposit move to it? |
|---|---|
| Pending start | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Notice pending | No |
| Disconnected | No |
| Closed | No |

An agreement of another customer never receives the deposit.

## Hypothetical illustration

A Residential New Service Deposit became fully secured on 1 February and carries a refund review date of 1 February of the following year. The customer stops service at the old address and starts service at a new address whose agreement is pending start. The deposit moves to the new agreement; its fully secured date stays 1 February, its refund review date stays 1 February of the following year, and its interest periods run on unchanged.

title: Security Deposit Waiver Bases by Deposit Kind
content:
Each Security Deposit kind offers its own set of waiver bases, its own request window and its own rule on who may record a waiver. A 0 in a window or months column means the basis or the waiver is not offered for that kind.

| Security Deposit kind | Waiver request window (calendar days after assessment) | Prior electric utility letter of credit reference: months of satisfactory payment shown | Closed Lakeshore agreement ended within the last 12 months: months of satisfactory payment | Current income qualification waives | Senior age at or above which the deposit is waived (no balance owed on any agreement) | Medical certification on the agreement in active status waives | Customer care agent may record the waiver |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential New Service Deposit | 30 | 12 | 12 | Yes | 65 | Yes | Yes |
| Residential Reestablishment Deposit | 30 | 0 | 0 | No | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Residential Unauthorized Use Deposit | 0 | 0 | 0 | No | 0 | No | No |
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | 30 | 24 | 24 | No | 0 | No | Yes |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | 30 | 24 | 24 | No | 0 | No | Yes |
| Large Power Service Deposit | 0 | 0 | 0 | No | 0 | No | No |

## Keys to the matrix

- **Waiver request window**: calendar days after assessment within which the customer may establish a waiver basis; 0 means the deposit cannot be waived.
- **Prior electric utility letter**: months of satisfactory payment that a letter of credit reference from the customer's prior electric utility must show to waive the deposit; 0 means this waiver is not offered.
- **Closed Lakeshore agreement**: months of satisfactory payment on a closed Lakeshore agreement of the customer, ended within the last 12 months, that waive the deposit; 0 means not offered.
- **Senior age**: the age of the residential account holder at or above which the deposit is waived when no balance is owed on any of the customer's agreements; 0 means not offered.
- **Agent may record**: whether a customer care agent may record the waiver, as opposed to the credit department.

## Points of judgement

- A Residential Reestablishment Deposit can be waived only on a medical certification on the agreement in active status; the letter, prior-history, income and senior-age bases show 0 or No for that kind.
- A Small Commercial Service Deposit can be waived on a prior utility letter or a closed Lakeshore agreement showing 24 months of satisfactory payment; 12 months is not enough for that kind.
- A Residential New Service Deposit is waived for an account holder aged 65 with no balance owed on any of the customer's agreements; at 64 the senior-age basis is not met.
- The Residential Unauthorized Use Deposit and the Large Power Service Deposit show a window of 0 and offer no basis: they cannot be waived, and a customer care agent does not record a waiver for either.

title: Security Deposit Waivers and the Refund of Cash Received
content:
An assessed Security Deposit is waived when one waiver basis offered by its kind is established.

## Clauses

1. **Window.** The waiver basis must be established no later than the waiver request window after the assessment date. The window is counted in calendar days from the day after the assessment date, and a basis established on the last day is in time. The assessment date is read from the deposit record.
2. **Bases.** The bases are:
   - a letter of credit reference from the customer's prior electric utility showing at least the kind's required months of satisfactory payment, whose reference number the customer supplies;
   - a closed Lakeshore agreement of the customer, ended within the 12 months before assessment, with at least the kind's required months of service and no disconnection or returned payment;
   - a current income qualification, where the kind offers it;
   - an account holder aged the kind's senior age or more on the assessment date, with no balance owed on any of the customer's agreements;
   - a medical certification on the agreement in active status, where the kind offers it.
3. **Status.** Only a deposit in assessed status can be waived.
4. **Cash already received.** Any cash already received is refunded in full on the waiver, credited to the service agreement.
5. **Refund status.** A refund is posted only on a deposit in held, waived, refunded or cancelled status.
6. **Kinds an agent may not waive.** A deposit kind for which a customer care agent may not record a waiver is never waived by a customer care agent, and a request to waive it is handed to a human representative as not covered by policy.

## Boundary cases for the window (hypothetical dates)

For a kind with a 30-day waiver request window and an assessment date of 5 June, the first counted day is 6 June and the last day is 5 July.

| Date the basis is established | In time? |
|---|---|
| 4 July | Yes |
| 5 July | Yes |
| 6 July | No |

## Status table

| Deposit status | Can it be waived? | Can a refund be posted on it? |
|---|---|---|
| Assessed | Yes, on an established basis | No |
| Held | No | Yes |
| Waived | No | Yes |
| Refunded | No | Yes |
| Cancelled | No | Yes |
| Applied to final bill | No | No |

## Hypothetical case

A Residential New Service Deposit was assessed and the customer paid a first installment of USD 50.00 before establishing, within the window, a current income qualification. The deposit is waived and the USD 50.00 already received is refunded in full as a credit to the service agreement.
